title: Hotfix: disable experimental scheduler path under high stream concurrency
text:
Hotfix: disable experimental scheduler path under high stream concurrency

description:
Context: During the 2025-07-18 incident we saw elevated stream disconnects and periodic runtime crash-loops correlated with the experimental scheduler path when stream concurrency spikes. This PR introduces a conservative gate to disable the experimental path automatically at high concurrency and adds a metric so SRE can verify behavior during rollout.

Implementation notes: Change is intentionally minimal and only affects the scheduler selection logic; no request semantics changes.

Checklist: [x] linked incident timeline in ENG-4421 [x] targeted runtime tests [x] added metric `runtime.scheduler.experimental_disabled` [x] rollback plan: revert to previous tag runtime-2.18.1

Commits: 1) runtime/scheduler: add concurrency gate 2) runtime/metrics: export disable counter 3) docs: update runtime ops note

Changed areas: runtime/scheduler; runtime/metrics; ops docs

Review conversation: Rohan Mehta: Can we ensure the gate is only based on per-pod concurrency and not global? Hiro Tanaka: Yes, per-pod. Added log line with pod id + concurrency. Grace O'Connor: Please add a hard rollback trigger in the runbook reference. Hiro Tanaka: Added to ops note and referenced the hotfix runbook. Ethan Park: CI looks good; ensure image scan is green. (green)

CI: build pass; unit tests pass; image scan pass; perf smoke pending -> rerun -> pass

Merge: Squash merged. Deploy will follow the serving runtime hotfix procedure canary-first.

release_notes:
Emergency mitigation: default RW_SCHED_EXPERIMENTAL=0 when concurrent streams exceed threshold; adds metric and logging for gate.
